source: Blue-tee card for this 18-hole par-62 executive course (Robert Muir Graves, 1977), 4493 yds, 61.1/98. Par, men's handicap and Blue yardage agree hole-for-hole between greenskeeper.org/southern_california/los_angeles/el_cariso_golf_course/scorecard.cfm and offcourse.co/courses/scorecard/el-cariso-golf-course; yardages check to 2290/2203/4493 and par to 31/31/62. Handicap for hole 12 is 6, taken from offcourse.co: greenskeeper prints 12 for both hole 12 and hole 16, leaving 6 unused, and offcourse.co's 6/12 split makes the back nine a complete even 2-18 set while matching greenskeeper on all sixteen other handicaps. TWO RIVAL YARDAGE SETS EXIST — mscorecard.com/mscorecard/showcourse.php?cid=1314665801604, golflink.com/golf-courses/ca/sylmar/el-cariso-golf-course and golfpass.com's hole rows all print a longer set summing to 2319/2285/4604 (e.g. hole 5 at 408 and hole 18 at 408). That set is rejected: playelcariso.com states 'Par: 62 | Yardage: 4,493', and every published tee-set table, golfpass's own included, rates Blue at 4493/61.1/98 — golfpass contradicts itself between its tee table and its hole rows, and no rating anywhere supports 4604. Cross-checked against imported OSM geometry, which independently tags par on all 18 golf=hole lines: those OSM pars match this card hole-for-hole (31/31/62). Measured tee_center-to-green_center is shorter than the card on 17 of 18 holes as expected for straight-line vs. line of play (total 4136 vs 4493); the lone exception is hole 10 (+22), one of three holes where OSM maps multiple tee boxes and the importer takes the back-most, which sits behind the Blue marker.
